summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting two press releases regarding a major contract award. The company announced a 10-year, $54.6 million contract with a top-5 global consulting firm to modernize and secure a state government Health and Human Services System. Work begins November 2026, with expected annual revenue exceeding $5 million. This is an ordinary business development announcement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No securities transactions, corporate actions, or strategic changes are involved, so no special-situations category applies.
